findings.desc: Canonical Claude launcher proof/allowlist does not match the actual dispatch launcher shape: readiness uses split --output-format stream-json and extra args, while dispatch executes --output-format=stream-json with a prompt file. The allowlist must authorize the exact observable launcher shape actually used.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed by a2405256b and preserved after cleanup: Claude canonical launcher and dispatch allowlist now use the same observable argv shape, --print --verbose --output-format=stream-json <prompt-file>, and readiness smoke verifies the canonical equals-form. Verified with npm --prefix packages/main run build and npm --prefix packages/main run test:review-host-launcher-readiness-smoke.

findings.desc: Readiness evidence can persist bounded stdout/stderr provider output as diagnostic text, and the handler can then append/print it. B-d8ef acceptance forbids secrets or raw provider transcripts in gate evidence; store only enum-style sanitized diagnostics and remediation labels.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed by a2405256b: readiness diagnostics no longer persist provider stdout/stderr snippets; evidence records use bounded enum-style failureKind, remediation, and status fields instead of raw transcripts. Verified by review-host launcher readiness smoke and node scripts/verify-process-fact-contract.mjs.

findings.desc: Existing usage-ledger-budget smoke is failing because it still expects the old plain claude --print/JSON append behavior. B-d8ef cannot proceed while the branch is not test-clean; update the smoke expectations or launcher integration so existing coverage passes.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed by a2405256b plus scope acknowledgement 4b5fe2c63: usage-ledger parsing now handles Claude stream-json result events and usage-ledger/unattended dispatch smokes expect the canonical observable Claude launcher. Verified with node packages/main/dist/tasks/usage-ledger-budget-smoke.js, node packages/main/dist/tasks/usage-ledger-default-on-smoke.js, node packages/main/dist/tasks/usage-ledger-dispatch-smoke.js, review-escalation-smoke.js, review-assurance-floor-smoke.js, and node scripts/verify-process-fact-contract.mjs.

findings.desc: Concept re-review found the prompt-content Claude launcher contract was reapplied on current HEAD 7fbc9de0. Canonical readiness now uses split --output-format stream-json plus extra flags and <prompt>, buildClaudeSpawnArgs substitutes prompt contents, actual claude dispatch passes promptText, and smokes assert the drifted launcher. B-d8ef requires claude --print --verbose --output-format=stream-json <prompt-file> consistently across readiness, allowlist, actual spawn, and smokes.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed by 2a92b42c5: restored the required prompt-file Claude launcher contract across readiness, dispatch spawn args, unattended fake Claude smoke, and usage-ledger smokes. Verified with npm --prefix packages/main run build, npm --prefix packages/main run test:review-host-launcher-readiness-smoke, node packages/main/dist/tasks/unattended-dispatch-smoke.js, node packages/main/dist/tasks/usage-ledger-budget-smoke.js, node packages/main/dist/tasks/usage-ledger-default-on-smoke.js, node packages/main/dist/tasks/usage-ledger-dispatch-smoke.js, review-escalation-smoke.js, review-assurance-floor-smoke.js, and node scripts/verify-process-fact-contract.mjs.

findings.desc: missing: packages/main/src/core/lattice-dispatch.ts:1601-1614,2318-2323 real codex dispatch now inlines the full prompt-file contents as a literal codex exec argv element (renderRuntimeInvocationTemplate with promptMode:'contents', used because canonicalReviewHostLauncherSpec('codex').launcherArgv ends in a positional <prompt> instead of the old --prompt-file <path>). There is no size guard before spawnSync(codex, argv, ...) in providers/codex-cli.ts. Realistic reviewer/dispatch prompts (plan.md sections, diffs, story context) can exceed OS ARG_MAX, and runBoundedCodexProvider only classifies spawnError for ENOENT, so an oversized-argv spawn failure surfaces as an opaque exitCode=null diagnostic status with no argv-size hint. Only the smoke test in dispatch-run-smoke.ts exercises this with a one-line sentinel prompt, not a realistic large prompt.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed by 2e223d3a3: codex real dispatch now renders the canonical <prompt> placeholder as codex exec '-' and sends the prompt file contents through bounded provider stdin instead of a large argv element. Provider results now classify spawn setup errors including E2BIG as argv_too_large for clearer diagnostics. Verified with npm --prefix packages/main run build, dispatch-run-smoke, provider-codex-smoke, provider-gemini-smoke, usage-ledger-codex-gemini-smoke, and review-host-execution-readiness-smoke.

findings.desc: missing: packages/main/src/core/lattice-dispatch.ts:2233-2238 buildClaudeSpawnArgs still takes a ledgerOn boolean parameter but now discards it with void ledgerOn and always returns the canonical launcher argv regardless of value (both call-site tests assert OFF and ON now produce identical output). The dead parameter is threaded through the one call site with no comment explaining why it is retained instead of removed.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed by 2e223d3a3: removed the dead ledgerOn parameter from buildClaudeSpawnArgs and updated all usage-ledger smokes to assert the single canonical Claude prompt-file launcher independent of ledger state. Verified with npm --prefix packages/main run build, usage-ledger-budget-smoke, usage-ledger-default-on-smoke, and usage-ledger-dispatch-smoke.

findings.desc: missing: packages/main/src/core/host-execution-readiness.ts:260-343 classifyHostExecutionReadiness always classifies canonicalReviewHostLauncherSpec(host).launcherArgv against itself (line 272: classifyReviewHostLauncher(args.host, spec.launcherArgv)) because its args type carries no observed-argv field; probeHostExecutionReadiness (the only real caller) always executes the hardcoded canonical argv. Since the canonical spec by construction satisfies its own classifyReviewHostLauncher checks, launcher.launcherOk is always true and the wrong_launcher branch at lines 305-319 is structurally unreachable in production, despite HostExecutionFailureKind listing wrong_launcher as a possible outcome of this function. Real observed-argv wrong-launcher detection only happens via the separate classifyReviewHostLauncher(host, launcherArgv) call on stored/submitted probe rows in review-escalation.ts:603, not via fresh probes.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed by 2e223d3a3: classifyHostExecutionReadiness now accepts observedLauncherArgv and classifies that observed argv instead of always comparing the canonical spec to itself; the smoke now proves an observed agy --prompt-file argv returns wrong_launcher through the readiness classifier. Verified with npm --prefix packages/main run build and review-host-execution-readiness-smoke.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/core/usage-ledger/dispatch-usage.ts:167-247 adds Claude stream-json NDJSON output parsing (parseClaudeJsonEnvelope/selectClaudeStreamResultEvent), a direct consequence of CHK-002/CHK-003 switching the canonical Claude launcher to --output-format=stream-json (previously a single JSON envelope was expected). This is real production behavior with real ad hoc test coverage (usage-ledger-dispatch-smoke.ts CHK-002-labeled happy/edge checks at lines ~139-186, usage-ledger-prototype-pollution-smoke.ts LOAD-BEARING stream-json checks at lines ~519-576), matching the exact gap already caught once by lattice-review-concept as F-003 (resolved). But no checklist item declares dispatch-usage.ts or the usage-ledger-*-smoke.ts test files as touchpoints, and CHK-002/CHK-003 verificationIntent (happy/edge/adversarial) only describe host readiness/fallback gating and launcher argv shape - none mention stream-json usage-ledger output parsing. No verificationEvidence intentRef maps to this behavior. If this parsing regresses again, the formal intent-coverage system will not catch it (only an ad hoc concept re-review would, as happened before).
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed by cfae117 and 30dfe56: added CHK-003:edge:1 verificationEvidence for usage-ledger-dispatch-smoke and back-filled the corresponding verificationIntent from passing evidence. This formally covers packages/main/src/core/usage-ledger/dispatch-usage.ts Claude stream-json NDJSON parsing, final result event selection, malformed/truncated fallback, token usage extraction, and prototype-pollution resistance. Verified with node packages/main/dist/tasks/usage-ledger-dispatch-smoke.js and usage-ledger-codex-gemini-smoke.js.

findings.desc: Provider spawn error classification added E2BIG => argv_too_large and default spawn_failed plus widened spawnError handling, but provider-codex-smoke/provider-gemini-smoke do not exercise non-ENOENT/non-timeout spawn failures or assert spawnErrorKind/spawnErrorCode. Add coverage for argv_too_large and generic spawn_failed classification.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed by 28d1ad8f1: provider-codex-smoke and provider-gemini-smoke now assert ENOENT => missing_executable, E2BIG => argv_too_large, and EACCES/default => spawn_failed, including spawnErrorCode preservation, null exitCode, spawnError=true, and no retry for spawn setup failures. Verified with npm --prefix packages/main run build, node packages/main/dist/tasks/provider-codex-smoke.js, and node packages/main/dist/tasks/provider-gemini-smoke.js.

findings.desc: Host readiness proof records canonical launcher argv while executing a different argv shape. probeHostExecutionReadiness replaces both <prompt> and <prompt-file> with inline prompt text through launcherArgsForExecution, then classifyHostExecutionReadiness records spec.launcherArgv rather than the actual spawned argv. For Claude this can execute claude --print --verbose --output-format=stream-json 'Reply READY...' while evidence reports claude --print --verbose --output-format=stream-json <prompt-file>, so gate evidence can claim the canonical launcher was observed without proving that exact launcher. Fix by materializing bounded prompt-file launchers as real temp prompt files, passing the actual executed argv into readiness classification/evidence, and updating the smoke to assert the exact argv used by the probe.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed by b5a7923cf and 4f4e38199: probeHostExecutionReadiness now builds an execution plan from the canonical launcher, materializes <prompt-file> launchers as a bounded temporary prompt file, substitutes <prompt> with bounded prompt text only for prompt-valued launchers, executes that concrete argv, and passes observedLauncherArgv into classifyHostExecutionReadiness so evidence records the exact launched argv. review-host-execution-readiness-smoke now captures fake host argv and asserts row.launcherArgv matches the actual executed argv, Claude uses an absolute prompt-file path that is cleaned up, placeholders are absent from evidence, and raw stdout/stderr are not persisted. Verified with npm --prefix packages/main run build, node packages/main/dist/tasks/review-host-execution-readiness-smoke.js, and git diff --check.

findings.desc: Readiness probe generation now records concrete executed argv, but evidence validation still accepts literal <prompt> and <prompt-file> placeholders for ready host rows. launcherArgvPartMatchesCanonical treats placeholders as valid, reviewHostAvailabilityProbeRecordFromEvent accepts that classification, and the smoke helper readinessRow emits spec.launcherArgv for ready rows, so gate-valid readiness evidence can still omit the exact argv that was actually executed. Reject placeholders for available/executionReady/reviewReady host rows while keeping placeholders only for static specs/templates; update smoke to require concrete ready-row argv and add a negative assertion that placeholder argv on a ready host invalidates the record.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed by fbf92c937: readiness evidence validation now rejects <prompt>/<prompt-file> placeholders when a host row is available, executionReady, or reviewReady, while preserving placeholder support for static launcher specs/templates. review-host-execution-readiness-smoke now uses concrete argv for ready synthetic rows and adds a negative check that placeholder argv on a ready row is invalid; review-escalation-smoke was updated to emit concrete ready-row argv so fallback validator coverage remains aligned. Verified with npm --prefix packages/main run build, node packages/main/dist/tasks/review-host-execution-readiness-smoke.js, node packages/main/dist/tasks/review-escalation-smoke.js, and git diff --check.
